title: JWT Inspector & Weakness Checker
description: Decode a JSON Web Token and audit it for weak secrets, alg:none, risky headers and missing claims, entirely in the browser.

title: Naive Bayes Spam Lab
description: Train an explainable Naive Bayes spam classifier in the browser, teach it new messages and evaluate it on held-out data.

title: CSP Policy Evaluator
description: Grade a Content-Security-Policy header for XSS, clickjacking and allowlist-bypass weaknesses, with concrete fixes, entirely in the browser.

title: K-Means Clustering Lab
description: Step through k-means clustering with k-means++ seeding, elbow and silhouette analysis, click-to-add points and CSV import, entirely in the browser.

title: Web Log Threat Hunter
description: Paste Apache/nginx access logs to detect SQLi, XSS, traversal, Log4Shell, scanners and brute-force bursts with per-IP risk scoring, entirely in the browser.

title: TextRank Summarizer
description: Summarise any text with TextRank: PageRank over a sentence-similarity graph, with per-sentence centrality scores, entirely in the browser.

title: Email Header Analyzer (SPF/DKIM/DMARC)
description: Paste raw email headers to check SPF/DKIM/DMARC results, spoofing and phishing indicators and the forensic delivery path, entirely in the browser.

title: K-Means Clustering Lab
description: Step through k-means clustering interactively, compare random vs k-means++ initialisation and pick k with the elbow method and silhouette score.

title: TOTP / HOTP Lab
description: Generate and verify RFC 6238 one-time passwords with Web Crypto, audit 2FA settings and build otpauth:// URIs, entirely in the browser.

title: Decision Tree Lab
description: Train an explainable CART decision tree on your own CSV with a visual tree, rules, feature importance and what-if predictions, entirely in the browser.

title: Classical Cipher Cryptanalysis Lab
description: Encrypt and then break Caesar, Vigenère and XOR ciphers with frequency analysis, index of coincidence, Kasiski and Hamming distance, entirely in the browser.

title: BPE Tokenizer Lab
description: Train a byte-level Byte Pair Encoding tokenizer on your own text and watch it merge into LLM-style tokens, entirely in the browser.

title: Phishing URL Analyzer
description: Score suspicious links for typosquatting, homograph, obfuscated-IP and @-trick phishing tricks with explainable static heuristics, entirely in the browser.

title: Neural Network Playground
description: Train a neural network from scratch with backpropagation and watch the decision boundary evolve on circle, XOR and spiral data, entirely in the browser.

title: CIDR Subnet Lab
description: Calculate IPv4 subnets, split and summarise ranges and audit firewall allow-lists for over-broad or redundant rules, entirely in the browser.
